patch_description: Keep the direct-demand reward, but add a deliberately modest reward for useful two-hop routes. Unlike an unweighted two-hop term, this discounts routes through intermediates with high total in- and out-traffic, which are more likely to become transit bottlenecks. The terms connect links that form actual directed paths and stay below the quadratic-term limit. Raising the degree-penalty weight should also make the QUBO less willing to trade degree violations for small changes in the surrogate cost.
